description: Execute AL tests in Business Central using BCContainerHelper (Docker) or Chrome DevTools (SaaS)

test_range.description: Test codeunit ID range (format: StartId..EndId, e.g., 70200..70249)

container_name.description: BC Docker container name (optional, defaults to CURRENT_FEATURE_CONTAINER from .env)

company_name.description: BC company name (optional, defaults to BC_COMPANY_NAME from .env)
